Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Carlos Yulo completes golden collection as PH breaks through in Asian Games

blocks.text: Carlos Yulo’s gold medal collection is finally complete after winning the Philippines’ first gold in this year’s Asian Games.

items: Alex Eala suffers surprise Singapore Open exit as world No. 180 Russian scores shocker

blocks.text: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala’s Singapore Open main draw campaign comes to an end after she falls to Russia’s Tatiana Prozorova in their round of 16 clash.

items: CICC lifts Discord ban, asks NTC to restore access

blocks.text: The Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center lifts its ban blocking social communications platform Discord from working in the Philippines.

items: PH leads ASEAN, partner navies in West Philippine Sea drills

blocks.text: The Philippines hosts joint maritime security exercises in the West Philippine Sea involving eleven ships from eight countries.

items: Judge blocks Trump’s White House media ban, orders access to be restored

blocks.text: A federal judge orders U.S. President Donald Trump to restore White House access for journalists from CNN, MS NOW, and Politico. – Rappler.com
